capabilities.name: Audit real capability health
capabilities.description: Verify which Buddy capabilities have actual executors and whether the governed MCP connector fabric is reachable. Never treats registry names alone as proof of capability.

capabilities.name: Diagnose Buddy and core runtime
capabilities.description: Inspect Buddy source integrity, disk pressure, allowlisted service state, loopback health, MCP health, and canonical repository state without mutation.

capabilities.name: Repair safe internal runtime faults
capabilities.description: Execute standing-authorized reversible repair recipes: safe service restarts, disposable-cache cleanup, tracked Buddy source restoration from clean canonical main, verification, rollback, and repair receipts. No arbitrary shell or security-boundary changes.

capabilities.name: List governed MCP connectors
capabilities.description: Read the loopback-only Dominion MCP connector registry so Buddy knows which concrete internal connectors are currently available.

capabilities.name: Invoke governed read-only MCP connector
capabilities.description: Invoke a named connector from the reviewed Dominion MCP registry. The MCP server fixes targets and denies arbitrary URLs, arbitrary shell, and external mutation.
